Multiple hits do not cause more damage but do extend the duration.[[Category:Greater Acid Arrow items]] ** [[ Stone Prison]][[ Stone Prison]]: This weapon is invested with the power of the earth. On an attack roll of 20 which is confirmed as a critical hit it will attempt to turn the target to stone, as the [[Flesh to Stone]] spell.
